summary: The falsy test takes the input expression and convert_bool, which interprets yes/no, on/off, 0/1 strings as booleans.
questions: Will falsy treat the string 'no' as false?
How do I make falsy understand yes/no values?

answer_card.title: falsy test parameters
answer_card.answer_md:
- `_input` (required)
- `convert_bool` (false): treat `yes`/`no`, `on`/`off`, `0`/`1` as booleans, e.g. `'no' is falsy(convert_bool=true)`
